lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@nextcloud/files: 64,050 B in 18 modules on the memories-main page, of which its root dist/index.mjs is 28,807 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
1 delivered file carries no source map, so those bytes are counted but charged to no package.
74 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
